body: `select()` assigns `this.selected` via a redundant ternary (`ELEMENTS.includes(element) ? element : element`) and does not actually normalize anything. This is confusing and makes it look like there is intended normalization that isn't happening.

`absolutize(meshUrl, catalogUrl)` ignores the `catalogUrl` parameter and always resolves against `window.location.href`, which breaks resolution when the catalog is fetched from a different base URL (and also makes `catalogUrl` unused).
Unused constant `_parentWorld` is declared but never referenced. This adds noise and can trigger unused-var linting if enabled.

Line contains a Unicode replacement character (�), which usually indicates an encoding/copy-paste issue. Replace it with a normal punctuation character so the credit line renders correctly everywhere.

The PR title suggests a narrow change (“Fix/casting bip001 clip urls”), but this PR includes broad additions (SDK exports, worker config, terrain/world systems, UI, etc.). Consider updating the PR title/description or splitting into smaller PRs to make review/rollback safer.
